subject: Pilot extension and credit counteroffer for NovaFinance
messages:
From: Claire Boudreau <claire.b@novafinance.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Ahuja <samir.ahuja@novafinance.com>
Date: 2026-03-15T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Request to extend pilot window and talk about credit

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the onboarding help — the team has been running load tests and a short security review this week. We hit a change in scope (additional connector work that was not in the original MAP) so we need a little more time to validate results end-to-end. Can we extend the pilot by 3 weeks?

Given the extra time and added connector work, procurement is requesting a goodwill credit against the first invoice if we move to paid within 60 days. Happy to share the notes from the security review — Samir is copied.

High level ask:
- 3 week extension to the evaluation period (same resources)
- A one-time credit applied to the first invoice (amount TBD — procurement prefers a dollar credit rather than %).

Can you confirm feasibility and what you’d need from our side to approve?

Thanks,
Claire Boudreau
VP of Product, NovaFinance
[attachment: security_review_summary.pdf]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Claire Boudreau <claire.b@novafinance.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-15T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to extend pilot window and talk about credit

Hi Claire —

Appreciate the heads-up and the security notes. We can absolutely extend the pilot; to move quickly I want to propose an initial counter so we have alignment and Legal/Finance can prep the paperwork.

Our suggested path: 
- 2-week complimentary extension on the same instance (we can do 3, but need exec pre-approval for credits)
- A one-time invoice credit: either a fixed dollar discount (we typically cap at $6,000 for pilots) or a 25% credit applied to month-1, whichever you prefer
- If NovaFinance signs a PO for production within 45 days of the extended pilot end, we’ll apply the credit on that first invoice.

If that’s close to what procurement needs, I’ll route to Monica and Finance for approval and share an amendment (DocuSign) you can sign. If you truly need a 3-week extension and invoice-only credit, I’ll escalate to Sales Leadership.

Also: could you share a short note on acceptance criteria (success signals) so we lock the MAP? That makes approval faster.

Best,
Karthik
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[attachment: MAP_request_template.xlsx]

From: Claire Boudreau <claire.b@novafinance.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@novafinance.com>, Samir Ahuja <samir.ahuja@novafinance.com>
Date: 2026-03-16T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to extend pilot window and talk about credit

Karthik —

Thanks for the quick reply. Procurement’s preference is:
- 3 week extension (same infra)
- $7,500 credit applied on the first invoice (we need the credit as a line item on the invoice)
- We’ll confirm success criteria by EOD Friday — primary items are latency < 300ms p95 on key flows and an embeddings accuracy check against a labeled set.

If you can put 3 weeks + the credit in writing, procurement will prepare a PO and we can circulate to Legal.

Claire

On a practical note, Samir: I’ve attached the security notes we referenced earlier.
[attachment: security_notes_march15.pdf]

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-17T09:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: internal - NovaFinance extension request

Karthik —

If procurement is insisting on $7.5k credit and 3 weeks, we need to check margin and precedent. Two options: 
1) Approve 3 weeks + $7.5k credit but require conversion PO within 60 days and limit credit to usage cap (e.g., first 1M tokens).
2) Offer 3 weeks + $4k credit (no usage cap) to avoid setting a high-dollar precedent.

Given their size, I’d push for option 1 if they can commit to the PO timeline. I can pre-clear up to $6k; anything above needs Monica sign-off. Also attaching the last week’s usage export to double-check likely cost exposure.

- Priyom
Head of Revenue Operations
[attachment: usage_export_mar15-22.csv]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Claire Boudreau <claire.b@novafinance.com>, Procurement <procurement@novafinance.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-18T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot extension and credit counteroffer for NovaFinance

Hi Claire / team —

Thanks for the clear asks and the success criteria. After internal review here’s what Redwood can commit to now (we’ve attached a short amendment MFN_Counter_v2.pdf that spells the terms):

Final counteroffer (subject to amendment signature):
- Pilot extension: 3 weeks (same instance, unchanged performance profile)
- One-time invoice credit: up to $6,000 applied as a line-item credit on the first invoice, applied if NovaFinance issues a PO for production within 60 days of the extended pilot end. Credit limited to usage during the pilot up to 1,000,000 tokens; overage billed at standard rates.
- If NovaFinance requires $7,500 specifically, we can consider that with an upfront conversion commitment (PO within 30 days) — ask Procurement to confirm.
- MAP: we’ll lock on the latency and embeddings checks you outlined; please send the labeled set and we’ll run a verification.

Next steps: 
1) Claire — please confirm you can accept $6k credit with the 60-day PO window OR confirm the $7.5k ask with a 30-day PO commitment.
2) If you accept $6k, Monica will route the amendment for signature via DocuSign and we’ll extend the pilot immediately.

Doc links: amendment draft (DocuSign) — https://app.redwood.com/agreements/rdw-457/amendment
HubSpot deal: https://redwood.app/hubspot/deal/457

Karthik
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[attachment: MFN_Counter_v2.pdf, MAP_NovaFinance.xlsx]

From: Claire Boudreau <claire.b@novafinance.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@novafinance.com>, Samir Ahuja <samir.ahuja@novafinance.com>
Date: 2026-03-22T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot extension and credit counteroffer for NovaFinance

Karthik / Monica / Priyom —

We appreciate the flexibility. NovaFinance will accept the $6,000 invoice credit with the 60-day PO window and the 1M token usage cap. Procurement will generate a PO and target the production PO within that 60-day window; I’ll circulate the labeled embeddings set by EOD tomorrow for the verification runs.

Please proceed with the amendment and extension — Claire will sign when Legal confirms the DocuSign.

Thanks,
Claire
VP of Product, NovaFinance
